verifications.claim: Chime is currently experiencing a widespread verified outage as of April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Chime outage began April 1 shortly before 1 p.m. EST.'; R2: 'Chime experienced a possible outage Wednesday [April 1, 2026]'; R4: 'Chime experienced a widespread outage... Wednesday'; R7: 'The bugs popped up April 1 shortly before 1 p.m. EST.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm a widespread outage on April 1, 2026, verified by Downdetector reports and Chime status updates.

verifications.claim: Thousands of users reported issues accessing the mobile app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Nearly 80 percent of problems involved the mobile app... more than 16,000 users reported problems'; R2: 'Most users... issues with the mobile application... More than 16,000 users'; R7: 'nearly 80 percent of the problems were listed [on the app]... more than 3,800 reports'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state thousands of reports, with majority (80%) on mobile app access.

verifications.claim: Thousands of users reported issues checking balances.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Many users could not view balances... account balances not loading... more than 16,000 users reported problems'; R3: 'inaccessible account balances... Hundreds of Chime users reported issues'
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention balance issues amid thousands of overall reports (primarily app), but do not specify thousands exclusively for balance checking.

verifications.claim: Thousands of users reported issues using features like SpotMe and transfers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Affected services included SpotMe... ACH transfers... seven percent involved funds transfer failures... over 16,000 users'; R2: 'outages with features including SpotMe, Pay Anyone... ACH transfers... More than 16,000 users'
verifications.reasoning: Status page lists SpotMe and transfers as affected; 7% of peak 16k+ reports on transfers alone exceeds thousands, with SpotMe explicitly disrupted.

verifications.claim: Over 16,000 reports were made at the peak of the outage.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'At 10:33 a.m. PT, over 16,000 users reported problems'; R2: 'Update at 10:33 a.m. ... More than 16,000 users have reported an issue'
verifications.reasoning: Both sources directly state over 16,000 reports at 10:33 a.m. PT peak.

verifications.claim: The mobile app is primarily affected (roughly 80% of issues).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Nearly 80 percent of problems involved the mobile app'; R7: 'nearly 80 percent of the problems were listed [on the app]'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm ~80% of issues on mobile app.

verifications.claim: Chime’s official status tracker has acknowledged the incident.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Chime’s system status page... Later, it confirmed investigation into disruptions'; R2: 'Chime’s status checker now says that they are investigating the issue'; R4: 'Chime acknowledged the issue on its official status page'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm status page acknowledged/confirmed the incident.

verifications.claim: Chime’s official status tracker is working on a fix.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Chime’s status checker shows that they are still working on the disruption'; R4: 'Chime said engineers were continuing to work to resolve the issue'
verifications.reasoning: Status page explicitly states working on/investigating the fix.

verifications.claim: Chime has indicated that user money and personal information are secure despite the disruption.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'The money in your account and your personal information are secure'; R1: 'Customer funds remain protected even during outages... Customer funds remain safe and insured'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes from Chime status page and articles confirm security of funds and info.

verifications.claim: Chime is investigating a platform-wide service disruption.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'investigating a platform‑wide service disruption'; R1: 'Chime said it is investigating the situation'; R2: 'they are investigating the issue'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly quote Chime investigating the platform-wide disruption.
